# Dashboard Header

**Figma:** ◇ Master-Layout Primitives/Dashboard/Header (4122:33402): Type Control-Bar · Navigation · Main · Custom  
**Import:** `import { DashboardHeader } from "@zen-ds/react";`

One row of a dashboard page's header: a control bar (Search, filter Chips, a result count and the page's actions), a navigation bar (Breadcrumbs, notifications and the account), the page title row or your own row.

## Use it for
- The toolbar above a table or a list: Search, filters and the page's actions (type control-bar).
- A dashboard page's navigation bar outside an AppShell: where the page is, then notifications and the account (type navigation).
- A row of your own between the header rows, e.g. a period Segmented and a date range (type custom).
- Converting a Figma Header/Dashboard: every Primitives/Dashboard/Header row keeps its Type.

## Use something else for
- The app frame's top bar inside an AppShell → AppShell header · headerCenter · headerActions.
- A page title with breadcrumbs, Back or section tabs → PageHeader (type main renders the same row without them).
- Phone screens → TopNavigation and the mobile filter row (Chip › Mobile filter row).
- A toolbar inside a card or a table widget → a Stack in the card's header.

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/dashboard-header.json`.

### DashboardHeader
One row of a dashboard page's header (Figma ◇ Master-Layout, Primitives/Dashboard/Header 4122:33402): a 40px row (Button/Size/Medium) in one of Figma's four types. It paints nothing and adds no padding: inside an AppShell, put the rows in `sections` (Figma Header/Dashboard, which pads each row); the app frame's own top bar is AppShell's `header`. Spacing from the Figma scales: Gap/Medium between the row's groups, Gap/Small inside the action groups, Gap/XSmall between filter Chips. <DashboardHeader search={<Search size="md" placeholder="Search leaves" />} controls={<Chip variant="advanced">Status`</Chip>`} actions={<><Button level="tertiary">Export`</Button>`<Button level="primary">Submit leave`</Button>`</>} />

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "title">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"navigation" \| "main" \| "control-bar" \| "custom"` | `"control-bar"` | Figma Type. `control-bar` (Figma's default): Search, filter Chips, a result count and the actions. `navigation`: Breadcrumbs on the left, notifications and the account on the right. `main`: the page title row — it renders a PageHeader (use PageHeader directly when you also need breadcrumbs, tabs or Back). `custom`: your own row. |
| `leading` | `ReactNode` | — | Navigation · Figma Leading-Slots: usually `<Breadcrumbs>`. It fills the row's start. |
| `center` | `ReactNode` | — | Navigation · Figma Center-Slots (Nav-Center-Block): up to 400px in the middle of the row, e.g. a Search. |
| `trailing` | `ReactNode` | — | Navigation and Main · Figma Trailing-Slots (Nav-Trailing-Block): icon actions then the account, right-aligned, Spacing/Gap/Small apart — `<AppShellAction>` buttons (notifications with a dot or count) and an Avatar or account menu. |
| `search` | `ReactNode` | — | Control-Bar · Figma Search: a <Search size="md"> that filters the page, 320px wide. |
| `controls` | `ReactNode` | — | Control-Bar · Figma Control-Slots: filter Chips (`<Chip variant="advanced">`), Spacing/Gap/XSmall apart. |
| `subheading` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma Subheading. Control-Bar: what the filters leave, e.g. "96 results" (Heading/Subheading). Main: one line under the title (the PageHeader description). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | — | Control-Bar and Main · Figma Action-Slots: the page's buttons, right-aligned — Tertiary first, then at most one Primary. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Main · Figma Header-Text: the page title (Heading/1, an h1 unless `headingLevel` is 2). |
| `childTitle` | `ReactNode` | — | Main · Figma Child-Heading: a second title after the title, in Content/Neutral/Light (PageHeader `childTitle`). |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2` | `1` | Main · heading level of the title (PageHeader `headingLevel`). Default 1. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom · Figma Custome-Elements: the row's content, Spacing/Gap/Medium apart and centred. |
| `overrides` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>` | — | Figma instance overrides of the components in its slots, by layer. Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the slots. |

## ✅ Do
- Inside an AppShell, put the rows in sections (Figma Header/Dashboard): the shell pads each row and keeps the top bar its own.
- Give the Search a placeholder that names what it searches ("Search leave requests").
- Make filters Chip variant="advanced" in controls, each opening its own Popover (harness: dashboard-header/filters-are-chips).
- Write the result count with plural() and update it with the filters ("96 results", "1 result").
- Order actions Tertiary first and keep one Primary, last (harness: dashboard-header/one-primary).
- Use only the props of the row's type: search on a navigation row does nothing (harness: dashboard-header/props-of-type).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use Buttons as filters in controls.
- Don't put more than one Primary in actions.
- Don't stack two navigation rows, or a navigation row under AppShell's top bar.
- Don't leave type="main" without a title (harness: dashboard-header/main-needs-title).

## Accessibility
- Rows are plain groups: the Search, Chips and buttons carry their own names, and Breadcrumbs its own navigation landmark.
- type main renders a PageHeader whose title is the page's h1 (headingLevel 2 inside a tab).
- Name icon actions in trailing (AppShellAction aria-label: "Notifications"; the unread count is added to its name).

## Content
- The result count says what it counts ("12 leave requests"), not just "Results".
- Action labels name the outcome ("Submit leave", not "Add").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dashboard-header/props-of-type` | error | A DashboardHeader draws only its type's slots: control-bar search · controls · subheading · actions; navigation leading · center · trailing; main title · childTitle · subheading · actions · trailing; custom its children. | `zen-allow-dashboard-header-type: <reason>` |
| `dashboard-header/one-primary` | error | DashboardHeader actions hold at most one Primary button (the page's main action), after the Tertiary ones. | `zen-allow-dashboard-header-primary: <reason>` |
| `dashboard-header/main-needs-title` | error | A type="main" DashboardHeader is the page title row: it needs a title (the page's h1). | `zen-allow-dashboard-header-title: <reason>` |
| `dashboard-header/filters-are-chips` | warn | Filters in a DashboardHeader's controls are Chip variant="advanced" (each opens its own Popover), not Buttons. | `zen-allow-dashboard-header-filter-button: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
